text:
tess (pm): Quick sync: propose a two-tier "capacity+bundle" pricing option. Basic = shared routing + small token bucket, Pro = capacity-tier + larger bundle + SLA. Goal: give customers straightforward path from low-cost to committed seats.

omar (sales): customers keep asking for a simple step between payg and full dedicated. this could be it. question: do bundles map to routes or tenants?

tess (pm): start tenant-level bundles. route-level later if customers demand. keeps billing simpler for pilot.

li (eng): runtime: we can map bundle consumption to routing weight. technical work: token accounting + route overrides. estimate 2 sprints for core + 1 for docs.

jordan (finance): pricing thought: Basic subscription $49/mo + 25k tokens; Pro $499/mo + 1M tokens + opt committed capacity pricing. i'll run margin sims.

anna (legal): contract note: need clear definitions for "tokens", "capacity-tier", and overage handling. also include a clause about dynamic routing changes for safety.

mike (ops): ops note: Pro with SLA implies a soft reserve or dedicated pool. for pilot we can do priority queues only. committed capacity requires separate contract.

sam (devex): SDK exposure: boolean tier flag + headers for token use. also quickstart showing graceful fallback when tokens exhausted.

omar (sales): pilot ask: can we include a 30-day trial for Basic + 100% token top-up? helps adoption.

jordan (finance): trial ok for pilot. need usage export for revenue recognition. add token exports to billing pipeline.

li (eng): telemetry plan: emit token.balance and token.burn events per tenant. that'll help ops and finance.

anna (legal): will draft addendum language for trial and token terms.

tess (pm): launch criteria draft: 1) routing+accounting in staging, 2) pricing page and contract blurb, 3) 2 pilot customers, 4) monitoring dashboards.

mike (ops): will provision priority queue in us-west for pilot. need expected QPS from sales.

omar (sales): i'll find 2 pilots (1 startup, 1 mid-market). will ask for QPS windows.

sam (devex): i'll prepare quickstart + sample prompts showing behavior when tokens run out.

jordan (finance): will share sensitivity table Tue.

tess (pm): thanks team. if no vetoes i'll publish MRD snapshot by EOD Fri.

anna (legal): small redline: add data residency note for region-limited pools.

li (eng): agreed. region-limited pools add complexity; keep pilot US-only.

tess (pm): locking pilot: US-only, 2 customers, 30-day trial, tenant-level bundles. kickoff Wed 10am PT.
